messages:
ana: quick heads-up — after the int8 bring-up of the new LLM build, I'm seeing subtle token shifts for very long contexts (>64k). outputs start aligned then drift by 1 token around 4k-6k, then diverge by lots later. :eyes:
sam: ugh. can you paste a minimal repro and logs? which model/quant pipeline?
ana: model: red-open-65b-fp16 -> red-open-65b-int8 via our quant pipeline (round-to-zero variant). repro command below. logs attached.
ana: ```bash
python tools/run_local_infer.py \
  --model-path /mnt/models/red-open-65b-int8 \
  --prompt-file tests/long_window/prefix_32k.txt \
  --max-tokens 65536 \
  --batch 1 \
  --quant int8 \
  --kv-cache enable
```
ana: here's a minimal diff of tokenized outputs (gold vs int8) — note the first mismatch at token index 4123, then steady offset of +1 after 4123:
```
GOLD: ... 4119: 'world' 4120: ',' 4121: '\n' 4122: 'The' 4123: 'cat' 4124: 'sat'
INT8: ... 4119: 'world' 4120: ',' 4121: '\n' 4122: 'The' 4123: 'cat' 4124: 'sat'
-- okay until 4123 --
GOLD: 4123: 'cat' 4124: 'sat' 4125: 'on'
INT8: 4123: 'cat' 4124: 'sat' 4125: 'on'
-- mismatch shows up at 4126 in token stream (off-by-one after rewrite)
```
ana: logs show repeated cache write index like `kv_write_idx=4125` followed by next write at `kv_write_idx=4125` again (should be 4126).
kevin: that screams off-by-one in cache-commit when block boundary aligns with rotary blocksize. we added a fast path for aligned writes in the int8 kernel last week. :bug:
marta: could also be phase scaling table mismatch if we reduced precision of rotation constants. any evidence in the attention weights?
ana: i dumped attention diag for layer 10 around the mismatch window — weights look sane, but the kv index in the runtime is repeated. attaching short snippet:
```
[INFO] layer=10 step=4124 write_idx=4125 write_len=1
[INFO] layer=10 step=4125 write_idx=4125 write_len=1
[WARN] kv index collision detected for seq 0 at step 4125
```
sam: can you run a reproduce with kernel debug enabled? run on cpu fallback and compare. if cpu path doesn't show the repeated idx then kernel bug.
ana: ran cpu fallback — no repeat. kernel debug (int8) shows repeated index. patch hypothesis: when (seq_len % rotary_block == 0) the fast-path increments are skipped.
kevin: i can take a look at the kernel commit. likely candidate: commit 1f4b2a3 (int8 aligned-write optimization). if true, revert quick test.
infra-bot: started ephemeral test vm (t3-gpu-20) for @ana and @kevin — link: https://ci.redwood/test/1940202020
benchbot: perf numbers from int8 aligned write branch vs cpu fallback (single long-run):
  - int8 aligned: 78 tokens/s avg, mem p95 24GB
  - int8 reverted: 72 tokens/s avg, mem p95 25GB
  - fp16 baseline: 22 tokens/s avg, mem p95 48GB
benchbot: so aligned write gives ~8% perf uplift. but correctness > perf here.
marta: thanks for the data. if it's the commit, we should revert and run a test matrix: int8 aligned vs reverted across window sizes [8k,32k,64k,128k] and random prompts. add unit that asserts monotonic write_idx per seq.
ana: i'll open a quick reproducer PR with tests and attach the failing prompt set. also adding a regression eval to Redwood Optimize so this doesn't slip.
sam: TL;DR — probable off-by-one in int8 aligned-write kernel. revert, write regression tests, re-run perf matrix. tagging @kevin to lead kernel revert. :thumbsup:
kevin: on it. will post patch + CI results in this thread. ETA couple hours.
kevin: quick update — found the branch condition that skips increment in wrap case. pushing revert now. will kick long-window CI.
nana: ✅ reverted locally, re-run shows index increments monotonic; initial smoke run matches gold until 65k. will run full suite overnight. :tada:
sam: awesome. please add a short postmortem blurb to the PR describing perf/regression tradeoff and next steps for better guarded kernel changes.
marta: also add a metric in console: `kv-index-consistency` per model-version — can alert if mismatch is found in production.
ana: noted. thanks everyone.
kevin: pushed revert PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5123 — tests queued.
infra-bot: CI queued for PR 5123 — estimated run 40m.
nana: will follow up tomorrow with full eval report and benchmark table. :spiral_notepad:
